title: HNS wallet ABI and browser projection contracts
description: Canonical machine-readable bundle for private wallet ABI v2 objects, public browser projections, and signed release manifests. Consumers should reference the exact named $defs root for their trust boundary.
$comment: The private ABI frame schemas describe the JSON payload following the four-byte big-endian length prefix. The prefix and encoded byte ceilings are transport invariants and are not representable by JSON Schema.

wireId16.$comment: Canonical nonzero 16-byte unpadded base64url. The final character restriction rejects noncanonical trailing bits.

wireId32.$comment: Canonical nonzero 32-byte unpadded base64url. The final character restriction rejects noncanonical trailing bits.

publicOrigin.$comment: The browser adapter requires exact URL-origin canonicalization, equality to its independently authenticated document origin, and a secure origin: HTTPS, or HTTP only for localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, or ::1. That URL-host predicate is enforced by the runtime rather than approximated here.

hnsNameDisclosureV3.$comment: The approval-schema-v3 validator uses the exact pinned hns-covenants rules and requires nameHash == SHA3-256(name).

hnsNameDisclosuresV3.$comment: Wire producers sort by (name, nameHash); the approval-schema-v3 validator also rejects duplicate names or hashes and the 16384-byte approval-frame ceiling remains authoritative.

baseUnits.$comment: Consumers must also reject decimal values greater than 340282366920938463463374607431768211455; JSON Schema has no portable numeric ordering for decimal strings.

nonzeroBaseUnits.$comment: Consumers must also reject decimal values greater than 340282366920938463463374607431768211455.

permissionCapabilities.$comment: Wire producers emit these set values in the canonical order declared by hns-wallet-types; runtime validators enforce that ordering.

nonemptyPermissionCapabilities.$comment: Wire producers emit these set values in the canonical order declared by hns-wallet-types; runtime validators enforce that ordering.

approvalWarnings.$comment: Wire producers emit warning sets in enum order; runtime validators enforce that ordering.

providerMethods.$comment: Presence in this closed vocabulary does not imply runtime availability. The snapshot contains only methods supported by the negotiated runtime; hns_requestAccounts requires the service's atomic permission/account join and an explicit runtime account selector.

privateProviderCapabilitySnapshotV1.title: Private provider capability snapshot v1
privateProviderCapabilitySnapshotV1.description: Wallet-owned authority-scoped negotiation result. Generation zero is valid only before the first permission grant or revocation; a revoked authority retains its nonzero tombstone generation. This is never projected to website code.
privateProviderCapabilitySnapshotV1.$comment: Within providerCapabilities, walletSessionId and permissionGeneration must equal the sibling private binding. Standard JSON Schema cannot express equality between sibling instance locations.

privateApprovalPrompt.$comment: expiresAtUnixMs must be greater than the verifier clock and no more than 90000 ms in the future. Expected-request parameter equality is enforced by the runtime projection validator.

oneOf.$comment: The binding and capability snapshot wallet session and permission generation must be equal.

providerEventEnvelope.$comment: For connect and permissionsChanged, payload.permissionGeneration must equal binding.permissionGeneration. This cross-instance equality is enforced by hns-wallet-ffi.

privateWalletServiceFrameV2.title: Private wallet-service ABI v2 JSON frame payload
privateWalletServiceFrameV2.description: Private host/service transport only. These objects must never be accepted from or projected into website code.

publicApprovalProjectionV3.title: Public approval projection v3
publicApprovalProjectionV3.description: Browser-owned, display-complete projection of the private approval. It deliberately excludes provider bindings, host/service sessions, authority handles, request nonces, secret material, and arbitrary display lines.
publicApprovalProjectionV3.$comment: The verifier also checks expiry against its current clock (maximum lifetime 90000 ms), exact origin/request binding, requested parameters, amount/fee asset equality, chain/finality mapping, and u128 upper bounds.

publicProviderEventProjectionV1.title: Public provider event projection v1
publicProviderEventProjectionV1.description: Normalized website-facing event projection. Private ABI sessions, sequences, authority handles/revisions, wallet sessions, and binding objects are deliberately absent. Chromium carries this normalized object inside its separately validated channel/direction wrapper; this root does not describe that enclosing extension window message.

signedArtifactManifestV2.title: Signed wallet artifact manifest v2
signedArtifactManifestV2.description: Strict release metadata for an independently built wallet-service artifact. Structural validity and a well-shaped signature do not establish authenticity or runtime availability.

antiRollback.$comment: The verifier must durably retain an accepted high-water sequence per releaseLine, require strictly increasing sequence, and bind previousManifestSha256 to the prior accepted manifest except for an explicitly trusted genesis.

signature.$comment: The signed payload is the RFC 8785 canonical form of the complete manifest with the signature member omitted. keyId selects verifier-owned trust configuration; no public or trusted key is accepted from this manifest.
